transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As we begin our finalization meeting for the 'Tide Memory' opening-night package, I'd like to go through our standard process. I need each of you to report any confirmed production requirements from your areas before I can sign off on the final exhibition plan. We have the current draft with eight stations, 15-minute sessions, unrestricted visitor recording, and a general accessibility notice. Let's start — technical producer, could you walk us through what you've confirmed on your end?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a confirmed technical requirement from my equipment test. The installation can only run reliably on six stations, not eight as the current draft plan specifies. Additionally, each headset requires a five-minute sanitation reset between sessions. I recorded this in my technical worksheet after yesterday's systems check, but I should note that worksheet hasn't been attached to the festival master brief yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report a confirmed rights requirement. I received the countersigned license addendum from the distributor this morning. The festival license for 'Tide Memory' permits exactly three public showings and prohibits visitor recording entirely. These limits have not yet been entered into the event contract summary, so the current draft plan — which allows unrestricted visitor recording — is not compliant with our license terms.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to report my confirmed accessibility requirements. My accessibility review, completed with the access consultant on Tuesday, requires exactly two captioned companion tablets and a seated orientation before each session. The resulting access specification is still in my department's review folder and hasn't been incorporated into the draft exhibition plan yet, so the current general accessibility notice doesn't reflect these confirmed requirements.

I heard back from the creator's agent today by email: the creator can attend only on opening night at exactly 6:30 PM for a 15-minute audience Q&A. I have not yet updated the guest schedule with this confirmation, so it is not reflected in the current draft package.
